Question B-001-016-010.

Why the correct answer is right: Fast-scan television on 14.23 MHz is prohibited because the mode is too wide for that HF context.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Slow-scan television (SSTV) on 14.23 MHz": Slow-scan television on 14.23 MHz is not the prohibited choice in the official answer.
- sourceIndex 2: "Frequency modulation (FM) on 29.60 MHz": FM on 29.60 MHz is not the prohibited combination tested here.
- sourceIndex 3: "Single sideband (SSB) on 3.76 MHz": SSB on 3.76 MHz is not the bank's prohibited example for this item.
